Majorant déduit du bruit thermique de Jo: An upper bound derived from Johnson-Nyquist thermal noise, not an ohmmeter reading: the source cannot be more resistive than this. It is its VARIATION that tells you something — a drying contact sends this number up by a decade.

Sépare l'excitation de l'enveloppe et ré: Separates the excitation from the envelope and reveals the slow periodicities that a drifting background hides.
Un seul mot par événement. Le plus honnê: One word per event. The most honest setting: nothing is added that has not been measured.
Le verbe et son intensité. Court, lisibl: The verb and its intensity. Short, legible, with no syntax that would suggest a thought.
Sujet, verbe, intensité, parfois une cir: Subject, verb, intensity, sometimes a circumstance. This is the setting shipped by default.

Une pince sur une feuille humidifiée, un: A clip on a moistened leaf, a probe in the substrate. The contact takes ten to thirty minutes to settle: this is normal, and it is measurable.
Onglet Multimètre : la qualité du contac: Multimeter tab: contact quality must read “fair” or “excellent”. If it does not, moisten.

Onglet Écoute : choisir un profil. « Déc: Listening tab: choose a preset. “Discovery” makes every event audible; “Meditation” spaces the notes out.
Ctrl+R. Une séance est un répertoire : W: Ctrl+R. A session is a folder: WAV, CSV and JSON, all readable without this software.
Ce n'est pas une traduction. La plante n: This is not a translation. The plant has no language; these words are those of the chosen dictionary, applied to measured quantities according to the rules shown opposite. What is said here is a dialogue between you and your own frame of reading.
un montage proche — le contact a pu chan: a close setup — the contact may have changed
Mesurée entre {f1} et {f2} Hz, où la pla: Measured between {f1} and {f2} Hz, where the plant produces nothing any more. This is the chain's own noise: electrode, cable, amplifier.
Déduite du bruit thermique (Johnson-Nyqu: Derived from thermal (Johnson-Nyquist) noise at 20 °C: R = Sᵥ / 4kT. It is an UPPER BOUND — the amplifier's noise and whatever the rig picks up are added in — but it climbs by a decade when a contact dries out, and that is where it earns its keep.
Le bruit intégré là où vit l'activité vé: Noise integrated where plant activity actually lives. This, and not the total noise, is what the sought events' amplitude must be compared against.
Résidu à {f} Hz, au-dessus du plancher: Residue at {f} Hz, above the noise floor
Ce que le montage capte du secteur. Au-d: What the rig picks up from the mains. Past 20 dB it is the shielding and the guard that need revisiting — not the notch filter, which hides the problem without solving it.
Rapport de la crête à la valeur efficace: Ratio of peak to RMS. Around 3 to 4 for Gaussian noise; much higher when clear-cut events stand out, which is a good sign.
−10 dB par décade est la signature d'un: −10 dB per decade is the signature of 1/f noise, that of electrodes and living media. A flat slope signals dominant white noise — often the electronics, not the plant.
Stabilité empruntée à la métrologie du t: Stability borrowed from time metrology: unlike the standard deviation, it tells noise — which improves with averaging — apart from drift, which worsens.
The most favourable averaging time. Beyond it, averaging longer DEGRADES the measurement: drift outweighs noise. Observed regime: {regime}.
bruit blanc dominant (moyenner améliore: dominant white noise (averaging improves the measurement)
Durée au bout de laquelle le signal ne s: The time after which the signal no longer resembles itself. It gives the inertia of the system being measured, and the shortest analysis window that still means something.
Au-dessus de 0,05, la distribution est c: Above 0.05 the distribution is consistent with a normal law and a threshold in standard deviations means something. Below, that threshold becomes questionable — and that is often a good sign: it means something is happening.
Ce que la chaîne offre réellement, bruit: What the chain really delivers, noise included, over the converter's full scale — always less than its nominal 24 bits.
Ce qu'il reste avant que le convertisseu: What is left before the converter hits its limit. Below 10 %, a clear-cut event will be clipped, and clipping cannot be undone afterwards.
Au seuil de {sigma} σ en vigueur. Le tau: At the {sigma} σ threshold currently in force. The rate depends as much on the threshold as on the plant: change it and you change the rate.
Variance divisée par moyenne du comptage: Variance divided by mean of the count. It equals 1 for a purely random process; below, the events are regular; above, they come in bursts. About ten events are needed before this number means anything.
Coefficient de variation des intervalles: Coefficient of variation of the intervals. Below 0.6 the events are too regular to be botanical — look instead for a pump, a ventilation system or automatic watering. Above 1.4 they come in bursts, which is the expected behaviour of living tissue.
